identity.domain: Real Estate CRM & Employee Workflow Management
identity.vibe: Premium, trustworthy, corporate SaaS, high-end real estate, clean and data-dense

typography.font_strategy: The 'Old Money Tech' strategy but modernized. Sharp, authoritative geometric sans for headings, clean humanist sans for body.

layout_and_spacing.sidebar: w-[260px] collapsed:w-[72px] h-full border-r border-border transition-all duration-300
layout_and_spacing.header: h-16 border-b border-border flex items-center px-6 justify-between shrink-0
layout_and_spacing.content_area: flex-1 overflow-auto p-6 md:p-8 bg-background gap-6 flex flex-col
layout_and_spacing.spacing_system: Use generous padding in empty states (p-12), tight padding in data cards (p-4 or p-6).

cards.style: Subtle border, flat appearance. No drop shadow in dark mode. 1px border is mandatory.

kanban.board: flex gap-4 overflow-x-auto h-full pb-4 items-start
kanban.column: min-w-[300px] w-[300px] bg-slate-100/50 dark:bg-slate-800/20 rounded-lg p-3 flex flex-col gap-3
kanban.card: bg-surface border border-border rounded-md p-4 shadow-sm cursor-grab hover:-translate-y-0.5 transition-transform

data_tables.style: Dense and scannable. Left align text. Badges for status.
data_tables.header: text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-text_secondary border-b border-border pb-3
data_tables.row: border-b border-border/50 hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/50 transition-colors py-3

empty_states.style: Elegant, non-jarring. Central illustration, subtle text, primary action button.
empty_states.classes: flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-12 text-center h-full min-h-[400px] border border-dashed border-border rounded-xl

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-white hover:bg-primary_hover rounded-md px-4 py-2 font-medium transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-surface border border-border hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 rounded-md px-4 py-2

login_background.description: Modern architectural interior, premium corporate feel. Used for the auth/login split screen.

empty_state_leads.description: Minimalist document illustration. Use in CRM lead panels when no data is present.

empty_state_whatsapp.description: Minimalist communication illustration. Use in the WhatsApp Campaign Panel when no campaigns exist.

real_estate_buildings.description: High-rise modern building. Use for property thumbnails or site visit location placeholders.

employee_team.description: Professional business team meeting. Use for employee management header or onboarding.

instructions_to_main_agent: TECH STACK: Use standard React with Tailwind CSS, not React Native web styles unless strictly running in an Expo web environment. Given standard web context, use standard HTML divs.
Do NOT use 'Inter' for headings. Use 'Outfit' via Google Fonts (or similar system font like system-ui if Outfit fails to load).
Implement a seamless Dark/Light mode toggle. Default to Dark mode for the 'Jewel & Luxury' feel, but ensure light mode maps exactly to the provided colors.
The application starts completely empty (No fake data). ALL panels must gracefully handle empty states using the provided 'empty_state_leads' and 'empty_state_whatsapp' images.
Add 'data-testid' to every actionable button (e.g., data-testid='create-lead-btn', data-testid='toggle-theme-btn').
For charts (Pipeline Analytics, WhatsApp Stats, Revenue), use Recharts. Make sure chart grids and lines are subtle (border/10) and colors match the status hex codes provided.
Implement Local Email/Password Auth. The login screen should be a 50/50 split layout using 'login_background' image on one side.
